findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_batch, screen_url · Private data: screen_batch, screen_address, screen_prompt, screen_url, screen_secret, screen_diff · Public sink: screen_secret.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_batch, screen_url · Private data: screen_batch, screen_address, screen_prompt, screen_url, screen_secret, screen_diff · Public sink: screen_secret

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
